obfuscation_indicators: not certain when or if significant revenue
risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful revenue, customer concentration, expense, impairment, and tax-loss figures, but relies heavily on forward-looking expectations and conditional language regarding growth, margins, commercialization, and financing. Key risks include dependence on major customers, insufficient revenue to absorb manufacturing overhead, potential capital constraints, covenant-related funding needs, and uncertain utilization of tax carryforwards.
